WITH inserted AS (
            INSERT INTO jobs (queue, kind, payload, dedupe_key, run_at, max_attempts)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, COALESCE($5, now()), $6)
            ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
            RETURNING id, queue
        )
        SELECT id AS "id!" FROM inserted, pg_notify($7, inserted.queue)
